tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List theatrical ad campaigns in Qube Slate, optionally filtered by status or a text search on campaign name, client, or campaign ID.

query.description: Text to match against campaign name, client, or campaign ID.

status.description: Filter by campaign status, e.g. Active, Pending Approval, In Review.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get one Qube Slate campaign by ID, including its target groups and media items.

tools.name: list_target_groups
tools.title: List target groups
tools.description: List target groups (screen selections) in Qube Slate, optionally filtered by campaign ID or a name search.

campaign_id.description: Only target groups of this campaign ID.

query.description: Text to match against target group name or ID.

tools.name: list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List campaign media (CPLs) in Qube Slate with their content status, optionally filtered by campaign ID, content status, or a text search on media name, CPL name, or CPL UUID.

campaign_id.description: Only media of this campaign ID.

content_status.description: Filter by content status: Available or Missing.

query.description: Text to match against media name, CPL name, or CPL UUID.
